about: Conformance vectors for Auto mode's Cloud store (plans/cmux-next/auto-mode/DESIGN.md, 'The store's rules as built').
Two tests replay every case: cmux-tui/crates/cmux-auto-session/tests/conformance against FakeAutoCloud, and
backend/apps/api/test/auto-sessions-conformance.test.ts against the real routes. A case starts on an empty store
with one owner and no Auto machine. A step is one call:
advanceMs  the clock moves on this much first, and the lease alarm runs
by         'owner' or 'machine:<machine id>' (the VM install bound to that machine)
op         the AutoCloud trait method; id is the chat ('$created': the chat the case's last create made)
body       the request's JSON body ('$team' in set_machine: a team the owner may use)
sha256, text, fence   put_chunk and chunk: the chunk's name, its bytes as UTF-8, the writer's {holder, epoch}
expect     fields of the answer's JSON body that must match: an object matches when every key named matches,
a list when it has the same length and every item matches, anything else when it is equal.
'$set' matches any value that is there and not null: a time, which no vector can name.
chunk answers {text}; put_chunk answers nothing. With no expect and no refuse the call must succeed.
refuse     the refusal: its HTTP status and code, and lastSeq, missing or session when named
disputed   one sentence: the answer asserted is the real store's today, and is thought to be wrong
Nothing here names a time, a version or an id the store mints.

cases.name: a laptop registers and holds the chat at epoch 1
a later PUT changes what it names and keeps the rest
renewals keep a laptop's lease, and the lease runs 45 s from the last one
a lease that runs out with a turn running gives the chat to the Auto machine: a takeover at epoch 2
a lease that runs out while idle parks the chat; its laptop takes it back as it is, and the same renewal again is that renewal
a parked chat goes to another laptop only through a standby's renewal
a parked chat kept in the Cloud is not taken by a standby, and still goes back to the laptop it was parked from
a standby counts for 45 s from its last renewal
a laptop that lost the chat to the machine is answered lost, then waits as a standby
a laptop's writes at a stale epoch or as another holder are refused: events, chunk, snapshot, inbox ack, release
writes while a machine holds the chat: a stale epoch and a wrong holder on events, chunk, snapshot, inbox ack, release and the assignment ack
events go on in order from 1: a repeat is accepted, a gap is refused with the last seq stored
a chunk is kept under the name that is its hash, and a manifest is taken only when every chunk it names is stored
a message to a laptop's chat is delivered; its id is taken once; the inbox is read from the last ack
a message to a parked chat resumes it on the Auto machine; the machine keeps a deliver while the inbox is unread and loses it after the acks
a laptop's lease that runs out with a message unread gives the chat to the Auto machine
with no Auto machine a message to a parked chat is queued; setting the machine moves the chat to it
a queued message is read by the laptop that takes its parked chat back
no Auto machine set: a lease that runs out with a turn running parks the chat blocked no_machine, and it moves when a machine is set
a chat blocked on no machine goes back to its laptop when the laptop returns first
the machine hands the chat back to a standby only once its events, the snapshot that covers them and an idle renewal are in
no handback while the chat is kept in the Cloud
no handback while the assignment is unacked or a message is unread
the chat goes home to the standby that renewed last
at most 8 laptops stand by for one chat: a ninth drops the one that came first
a machine that said it was idle and stopped renewing gives the chat to a standby at the standby's renewal
a machine at work that stopped renewing keeps the chat
setting another Auto machine moves a chat the first never picked up, and leaves one a machine acked
a laptop releases an idle chat: it is parked, and that laptop takes it back as it is
a laptop releasing with a message unread and no Auto machine leaves the chat parked and blocked
a laptop releasing with a message unread gives the chat to the Auto machine
a machine's release hands the chat to its standby with no snapshot check
the Auto machine releasing with a message unread keeps the chat at the same epoch
auto: false is refused held_in_cloud while a machine holds the chat, for a parked chat a machine ran last, and for the laptop that took it until it stored its own snapshot
after auto: false the chat is closed: its copy is gone, every write is refused auto.closed, and auto: true opens it again, empty, at the next epoch
a chat started with no laptop: the Auto machine holds it with a create to pick up, and the same request again is the same chat
a route answers only its caller: a machine cannot use the owner's routes or reach a chat it does not hold, and the owner cannot use a machine's
before the first snapshot a message starts no machine: the chat is parked, the message waits, and its laptop takes the chat back and reads it
a machine that acked a message keeps the chat when the owner sets another Auto machine: the message is in its log alone
a PUT from the laptop a parked chat was parked from takes it back as it is; from another laptop it changes nothing
a laptop handed the chat that lets its lease run out before its own snapshot leaves the chat parked as the Cloud's: it comes back as a standby, and auto: false waits for its snapshot
a PUT from the laptop that holds the chat renews its lease: the chat is still its own past the first lease's end
the person moves a laptop's chat to the Cloud in the middle of its lease: a wish the laptop reads at its renewal and answers with a give once a snapshot covers its last event
the person moves a machine's chat to a laptop: the machine reads the wish at its renewal and gives the chat to the laptop that stands by, which imports before Auto can go off
a parked chat moves at once: to the Auto machine only with a snapshot to import, and to a laptop that stands by, which imports first
a parked chat moved to the laptop it was parked from is taken as it is: nobody ran it since, so Auto can go off at once
a parked chat that is kept in the Cloud and has a snapshot is not taken back by its laptop: it waits, and a message starts the Auto machine
a PUT that stops keeping a parked chat in the Cloud takes it back for the laptop it was parked from
a wish ends when the person asks the chat back, 120 s after it was asked with no give, and with any other change of holder
a chat started with no laptop is made in Cloud mode when asked; a move is the owner's or its holder machine's, names a laptop only to go local, and changes nothing for a chat that is already there
a move to the Cloud needs an Auto machine, and a chat with Auto off does not move
